r2.conclusion: Carry produced a positive public-team-risk signal, but removing Carry would still select the same route in this fixture.

nextFixture.rule: Threat HP must equal the local attack's actual damage D so killing the threat and hitting another target reduce total EnemyHp by the same amount.
nextFixture.starterIroncladExample: With no Strength/Vulnerable and Strike damage 6, prepare an AllPlayers threat to exactly 6 HP and keep an Unknown/non-attacking enemy above 6 HP.
nextFixture.retryLimit: At most one additional ordinary multi-enemy fixture if the first exact-damage fixture remains UNVERIFIED.
